A QUICK GUIDE

Find your way
with words.

01

Cross a word

Place words across or down. Cross exactly one existing word at a matching letter.

02

Keep it economical

Each word costs 10 points, plus 1 per letter. Fewer points means a better connection.

03

Close the gap

Your final bridge may cross two words, one from each group, to complete the puzzle.

About the word list & placement rules

This edition includes an expanded English word list, with plurals and inflected forms. Words must be 2–15 letters, cannot be repeated, and cannot overlap in the same direction. Neighboring words need a blank square between them unless they cross. Clues are free. Each gives a starting square, an ending square, and a description of a possible word without revealing the answer.
